about: Owner questions that MP-40's story drafting found and that no earlier record held. Each has an id stories can cite, the stories it blocks and the evidence or consequence that decides it. Answers are recorded in the decision log, and the status here changes to owner_confirmed.

questions.question: What upload limits apply to an import: maximum file size, pages, image pixels and parser runtime?
questions.decides: Whether a large statement is refused, split or processed; until the owner records values, no limit is treated as approved and oversize files are held for review.

questions.question: How should an encrypted PDF statement be unlocked: on the owner's device before upload, or by entering the password in a local-only step?
questions.decides: Whether MP ever handles a statement password; until answered, an encrypted PDF is held as needing unlock and its password is never logged or sent to a model.

questions.question: Is WCAG 2.2 Level AA MP's accessibility standard for the web app and the Apple app's equivalent checks?
questions.decides: The pass mark for every screen's accessibility checks (MP-36 proposed it; ARCHITECTURE.md says only accessible and responsive).

questions.question: Add the three further service control policies MP-29 proposed (keep CloudTrail on, deny root actions, forbid leaving the organisation) beside the cost-guard SCP?
questions.decides: Whether the guard rails stop those actions by policy or only by IAM and alarms; the owner adopted Organizations and the cost-guard SCP and rejected the Region allowlist and RCPs, but did not answer these three.

questions.question: Adopt an Anthropic admin key so the prod billing collector can read Claude usage and cost?
questions.decides: Whether Claude spend is collected automatically or shown as unavailable; the key would be held in SSM and read only by the collector.

questions.question: Approve the cost freshness rules: AWS billing data older than 36 hours blocks optional work, credit proof must be under 30 minutes old, and a £15 emergency window?
questions.decides: When stale cost data stops optional work (gap CT-13); until approved, optional paid work waits for fresh cost data.

questions.question: At PH-08, keep N0 (no VPC) or take a lockdown step (L1 to L4), each costed on the perimeter page?
questions.decides: The network for the personal launch; the decision log says it is decided at PH-08, and every paid step overruns the £22 AWS share.

questions.question: Which source, if any, should supply fund look-through holdings for exposure and overlap (fund factsheets, provider holdings data or none)?
questions.decides: Whether fund exposure looks through to the underlying shares; no fund-holding source has an accepted risk scope, so look-through stays shown as missing until the owner chooses.

questions.question: How long may a chat-proposed catalogue change (a new market, segment or watch-only listing) wait for the owner's confirm before it expires?
questions.decides: When a stale proposal is refused (gap CT-02); POLICY-001's 15 minutes covers financial writes only, so until answered a proposal is refused once its coverage check is no longer current.

questions.question: Which news, filings and economic-calendar sources should MP read for the seven event kinds?
questions.decides: What the event pipeline can see; no source is selected and their use rights are unverified, so intake stays off until the owner chooses.

questions.question: What makes a risk alert material or critical, and is there a weekend brief?
questions.decides: How often the owner is alerted and on what (gap CT-18); until answered, alerts use the proposed thresholds and are labelled proposed.

questions.question: Which iPhones, iPads and iOS versions are supported, what 'Duo' means, and which data the app may keep offline?
questions.decides: The device test matrix and the offline cache contents (gap PL-14).

questions.question: For each native capability (widgets, Spotlight search, share, Siri and App Intents, Live Activities), launch or later?
questions.decides: Which native features the first Apple build includes; none is silently dropped.

questions.question: On the home screen, should holdings come first with the top 5 per segment below, or market discovery first with holdings a tap away?
questions.decides: The home screen's order. The owner asked for 'holdings plus the top 5 per segment' (3 November 2026) while ARCHITECTURE.md section 11 says 'market discovery first, holdings a tap away'; under the plan-sync rule both stay as they are until the owner answers.
